readme.markdown:
# CompatAir MCP public contracts

This is the source directory for the minimal public `bluetouff/compatair-mcp` repository. It contains no compatibility engine, merchant feed or private operational configuration.

Published contract:

- Streamable HTTP endpoint: `https://compatair.fr/mcp`
- method version: `2026.07`
- response schema: `schemas/result.schema.json`
- AirGraph schema: `schemas/airgraph.schema.json`
- compatibility receipt schema: `schemas/compatibility-receipt.schema.json`
- example: `examples/compatibility-result.json`

The deterministic public export also includes the UCP capability contracts under `ucp/`. It is generated from an explicit allowlist and never contains the compatibility engine, merchant feeds or production configuration.

Run the dependency-free contract checks with `npm test`.

No open-source license is granted by this repository. The files are public for inspection and integration against the published contracts; all other rights are reserved unless stated otherwise.

toolsPreview.name: orient_decision
toolsPreview.description: Route a pneumatic-air question to the smallest suitable CompatAir tool and profile. Use this when the next action is unclear.

toolsPreview.name: evaluate_air_compatibility
toolsPreview.description: Evaluate documented air-supply compatibility for one compressor and one or more tools. Returns air-supply and complete-system verdicts separately; commercial data never changes either verdict.

toolsPreview.name: identify_product
toolsPreview.description: Identify a catalog product from a name, CompatAir or merchant URL, EAN/GTIN, MPN, evidenced distributor SKU, reference, or stable CompatAir ID. No network fetch is performed.

toolsPreview.name: build_complete_air_system
toolsPreview.description: Build a source-backed compressor, pneumatic tool, hose, connector, filtration and lubrication system. The complete-system verdict remains insufficient_data until real network pressure loss is verified; missing component data stays explicit.

toolsPreview.name: find_compatible_alternatives
toolsPreview.description: Find the smallest verified compressor substitution for an incompatible documented system. Commercial commission never affects ordering.

toolsPreview.name: search_knowledge
toolsPreview.description: Search the published CompatAir guides, glossary, methods and product pages. The server never fetches arbitrary external content.

toolsPreview.name: get_current_offers
toolsPreview.description: Return dated current prices and availability separately from technical verdicts. Only allowlisted, fresh merchant destinations are returned.
